name: MICROLN
recent: Microlink Solutions 近期完成供股与凭单发行，并获马来西亚移民局合约延长，价值 RM60 million。同时，大股东 Teguh Sedaya 和 Omesti 增持股份，公司委任 Yap Shon Leong 为执行董事。最新季度营收同比大增但净利仍亏损。
notable: 子公司获得马来西亚移民局合约延长，价值 RM60 million。
完成可放弃供股，发行 536,198,072 股新股及 536,198,072 张免费凭单。
委任 Yap Shon Leong 为执行董事，自 2026 年 11 月 17 日起生效。
risks: 最新季度净亏损 RM5.666 million，亏损状态持续。
供股发行大量新股及凭单，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
earnings: 2026财年第四季度营收为 RM178.218 million，环比增长 81.6%，同比增长 243.6%；净亏损为 RM5.666 million，净利率 -3.2%，较上季度的 -4.0% 略有改善。

recent_en: Microlink Solutions recently completed a rights issue with warrants and secured a RM60 million extension of its Malaysian immigration contract. Meanwhile, substantial shareholders Teguh Sedaya and Omesti increased their stakes, and the company appointed Yap Shon Leong as Executive Director. Latest quarterly revenue rose sharply year-on-year but net loss persisted.
notable_en: Subsidiary secured a RM60 million extension of its Malaysian immigration contract.
Completed renounceable rights issue of 536,198,072 new shares with 536,198,072 free warrants.
Appointed Yap Shon Leong as Executive Director effective November 17, 2026.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation.
Latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM5.666 million, with losses continuing.
The rights issue of a large number of new shares and warrants may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
earnings_en: 4Q FY2026 revenue was RM178.218 million, up 81.6% QoQ and 243.6% YoY; net loss was RM5.666 million with a net margin of -3.2%, slightly improved from -4.0% in the previous quarter.
